mapper.select: SELECT U.USER_ID, U.DEPT_ID, U.LOGIN_ID, U.PASSWORD_HASH, U.USER_NAME, U.ENABLED, D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME FROM USERS U JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON D.DEPT_ID = U.DEPT_ID JOIN POSITION P ON P.POSITION_ID = U.POSITION_ID WHERE U.LOGIN_ID = #{loginId}
SELECT R.ROLE_CODE FROM USER_ROLE UR JOIN ROLE R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE UR.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.ROLE_CODE
SELECT DEPT_ID AS "id", DEPT_NAME AS "name" FROM DEPARTMENT ORDER BY DEPT_NAME
SELECT POSITION_ID AS "id", POSITION_NAME AS "name" FROM POSITION ORDER BY POSITION_LEVEL, POSITION_ID

SELECT ROLE_ID FROM ROLE WHERE ROLE_CODE IN
#{roleCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERS ( USER_ID, DEPT_ID, POSITION_ID, LOGIN_ID, PASSWORD_HASH, USER_NAME, ENABLED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{positionId}, #{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{userName}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP )
